# Attribution, modifications and licenses

[简体中文](ATTRIBUTION.md) · [Project overview](../README.en.md)

This repository's product is **DeepSeek Harness**, Android package `app.dsh`, maintained as a minimal modified edition by **wanan8396**. This documentation revision is dated 2026-11-11.

## Upstream source

The project is derived from **ccch1mneyyy**'s [dsh-Go](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-Go). Original copyrights, authorship, source-file headers and third-party notices are retained. This edition centres the original webpage and reduces native settings and additional features. Upstream promotional artwork, download links and community links are not presented as this repository's product overview.

The engine comes from [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). Engine and Android-client versions and releases are managed separately; this client is not an official DeepSeek release.

## Licenses

- Directories with separate licenses, including `sdk/` and `examples/`, retain those terms.
- Third-party code, fonts, runtimes and components retain their own licenses; see [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
- Rights and usage conditions for retained upstream brand/art assets remain in [ASSETS.md](../ASSETS.md). Renaming this edition does not transfer or change those rights.
- Current branding inputs and provenance are under [app/assets/branding](../app/assets/branding/). A supplied input image does not change existing copyright or trademark ownership.
- The [Purge archive](../vendor/dsh-purge-community/README.en.md) retains its original MIT license and author/community attribution, separately from the client code's AGPL license.

## Retained compatibility names

Source directories, bridge routes, skill IDs, URI schemes, the Kotlin namespace and historical developer material may retain older names. They are compatibility identifiers or provenance records, not the public brand of this edition. This Markdown cleanup does not mass-rename them or remove license/contribution records.
